pages.title: Infectious disease consult
pages.text:
## INFECTIOUS DISEASE CONSULT
Date: 10/02/2026 10:15
Reason: MSSA bacteremia
Blood cultures 09/30: MSSA 2 of 2 bottles. Repeat blood cultures 10/01 and 10/02: no growth to date.
MRI L foot 10/01: cellulitis of dorsal foot, no abscess, no osteomyelitis.
TTE 10/02: no vegetation, EF 60%.
## Recommendations
- Stop vancomycin. Cefazolin 2 g IV every 8 hours.
- Complicated MSSA bacteremia (fever >72h before clearance): total 4 more weeks IV cefazolin via PICC, end date 11/03/2026.
- PICC placement once repeat cultures negative x 48h.
- Home infusion and home health nursing needed for PICC care and weekly labs (CBC, BMP).
- ID clinic follow up 2 weeks after discharge.
Signed: R. Marsh, MD (Infectious Disease)
